content: Now would be a good time to break out the electric screw driver :)
I found it useful to place two nuts in each hole to hold the first one at the top.  Once the screws were in, I let the extra nuts fall out and tighten the screws in the rest of the way.

When using the screw pull method one of the nuts now free spins, making removing the pulling screw difficult. I have dribbled a little superglue down the sides and will leave over night and see if it will secure the nut enough so I can extract the screw. Failing that I will print a replacement part on my other machine.
